regions.full_page: Floyd McSweyn - now 24 - of Merrill, Mich - in May 1933 fell 18 feet on cement floor receiving to all reasoning fatal skull fracture and other injuries. His mother, sick at time, got out of bed and phoned to have him enrolled ... She tells us To-day that Fr. - assured her "the boy will be better inside of five-hours ... Blind and dumb and totally paralyzed at time mother phoned, asked for a smoke after. He had completely and perfectly recovered - save hearing in one ear.
